obernants.operator: End markers delimit parser substreams. Stream group_tokens/opt_tokens and macros collect_until explicitly restore End on their failure paths. Macro match_pattern literal matching consumes the next token before comparison and can consume End on mismatch; read_let can likewise consume an invalid End target. No universal scan-failure preservation law is claimed.
